title: nwjl.3: C: add claim_seq field to slot claims and NVS-backed replay cache
description: Spec GCP-6.5 step 8: MUST reject claim_seq <= cached. No claim_seq field or replay cache exists in C. Add u32 claim_seq to struct lichen_slot_claim, include in signature transcript, implement per-gateway-IID NVS replay cache. NOTE: overlaps with l1qw.20.1 — coordinate or merge. Add test with replayed claim_seq.
close_reason: Already implemented by the COSE migration (audit close): the COSE payload carries CLAIM_KEY_CLAIM_SEQ (claim_encode_payload), the receiver enforces the replay high-water (coap_slot_coord.c :430-437 — LICHEN_CLAIM_REJECT_REPLAY via lichen_slot_claim_seq_lookup), and the high-water cache is NVS-backed via slot_claim_settings.c (settings_save_one/settings_load_subtree, lazy rebuild at first use). Commit + NVS persistence both present. Remaining response-code mapping is tracked by nwjl.10/cdfh.
